messages:
Maya (AE): Opening thread for SummitBridge POC. They want SSO via OneLogin, SCIM provisioning for users+groups, RBAC group->role sync, and domain-locked admin accounts. Raj is our customer contact. Carlos can run the test tenant. Need a Dedicated pricing estimate for their expected load too.

Carlos (SE): On it. Raj: can you drop your OneLogin SAML metadata and SCIM base URL/token? Also confirm whether you want group sync to be authoritative for role assignment or just advisory.

Raj (Customer): OneLogin metadata coming in email. SCIM token will be created by our infra team and shared. We want group sync to be authoritative (i.e., IdP groups determine access). Need domain verification so only *@summitbridge.com become org admins.

idp-bot: Tip: rotate SCIM tokens every 90 days. See policy: https://help.onelogin.com/scim-rotate

Aria (Solutions Eng): For RBAC mapping format I suggest a simple CSV we can ingest: `idp_group,redwood_role,role_scope`. Example: `platform-admins,admin,org`. I can provide a template. Also SCIM attrs required: `userName,email,givenName,familyName,employeeNumber`.

Nina (Security): Security items to confirm: SCIM uses TLS 1.2+, token storage (we support KMS), audit trails for SAML auth and SCIM provisioning events, and certificate rollover procedure. We need to provide SOC2 report and KMS options for Private deployments. I'll attach the questionnaire answers to the thread.

Maya (AE): Good. Carlos 1 can you give a back-of-envelope Dedicated price for ~40 concurrent sessions and ~80M tokens/month? We'll consider a short evaluation credit for the POC.

Carlos (SE): Back-of-envelope: recommend Dedicated Standard commit. Rough estimate ~$18k/mo. I'll confirm with Sales Ops and generate an EVAL credit for 30 days.

Aria (Solutions Eng): Test plan for SE: 1) import SAML metadata to OneLogin, 2) hit SSO sign-in via test tenant, assert NameID=email, 3) create user via SCIM POST /Users, 4) add user to `platform-admins` group, 5) verify Redwood role change. I'll spin up a tenant and post ACS/EntityID.

Raj (Customer): We'll use NameID=email and want monthly cert rotation. Our compliance team will want to see cert rotation steps.

Carlos (SE): Tenant is live: https://eval.redwood.ai/summitbridge-qa  ACS endpoint: `https://eval.redwood.ai/saml/acs`  EntityID: `https://eval.redwood.ai/saml/metadata`. Rotation flow supports zero-downtime via metadata overlap. Command to trigger rotation (internal): `POST /internal/saml/rotate -H "Authorization: Bearer <admin_token>"`.

Nina (Security): Confirmed we support overlap uploads and can schedule monthly rotation. We'll provide a short runbook for the customer's compliance review. Also confirm audit events are exportable via S3/Logpush.

Maya (AE): Action items: Carlos - share quote and test URL by tomorrow morning. Aria - drop RBAC CSV template. Nina - attach security questionnaire answers and SOC2 link. Raj - share SCIM token + final group list.

Raj (Customer): Will email token and group list within 3 hours. Quick Q: can SCIM be rate-limited? We plan big user sync batch.

Aria (Solutions Eng): Default SCIM rate limit is 600 req/min; we can open a temporary increase for the POC bulk import. For large syncs we recommend using delta sync and batching at 200 users per minute.

Maya (AE): Perfect. I'll package the formal quote and the AUP/MSA checklist after Carlos posts numbers. Ping this thread when items are uploaded. :white_check_mark:

Carlos (SE): Posting results after SSO smoke test. So far sign-in works, SCIM create -> user appears, group->role mapping applied. I'll follow up with logs if anything fails.

Aria (Solutions Eng): Uploaded RBAC template to shared drive and pasted minimal example here: `platform-admins,admin,org\nengineering,developer,project`  Raj please replace with your exact group names and return.

Raj (Customer): Received. Sending group mapping and MSA now. Thanks all.
